meta.title: Specimen Sorter API
meta.subject: lis-crs-spec-ack-svc — one POST to auto-register or send out from a USID
meta.author: LIS Team

slides.headline:
One POST on Specimen Acknowledgement
registers or sends out a USID
slides.lede: Sorter middleware calls the Specimen Acknowledgement service. Soft alerts, hard checks, and packing move behind that call. Staff Spec Ack stays as the fallback.
slides.footer: Reviewed by Tony Chong  ·  SEM20260612  ·  JIRA not assigned
slides.notes: Cover is identity only. Production JIRA is not assigned; TMP-000 is the dossier stand-in. Reference SEM20260612. Tony Chong reviewed the design note.

slides.title: The sorter needs the staff click path in one call

steps.title: Staff scan and click
steps.body: Staff scan a USID, then click Send-out or Register.

steps.title: Writes are already in the service
steps.body: Lookup and writes live in Spec Ack. The screen still builds the register payload.

steps.title: One call, then a bin
steps.body: The sorter bins the tube from one LIS response in under four seconds.

callout.text: That call is tied to a fixed user.

slides.notes: Writes are not the gap. Middleware cannot call staff register without the payload the screen builds today.

slides.title: Packing still lives on the screen

left.label: Today
left.title: Screen owns the contract
points: Staff click after the screen packs the payload
Workbench comes from the PC login
Staff retrieve is tied to a fixed user

right.label: Proposed
right.title: One new POST
points: Alerts, hard checks, and packing run on the server
Reuse retrieve, send-out, register, worksheet, and PHLC
Staff screen stays as it is

callout.text: Do not reuse staff register or ECPath5 register. Both expect a different caller.

slides.notes: Staff register keeps screen packing. ECPath5 register keeps a hard-coded user.

slides.title: A new POST looks up, packs, then writes

fallthrough.label: No
fallthrough.title: FAILURE
fallthrough.body: Unknown sorter, APS/BBS/MBS, mixed tests, STAR with no location

terminal.label: No
terminal.text:
SEND_OUT if every test
is a send-out test
else REGISTERED

condition.label: Also on this path
condition.code: DFT uses ordinary Spec Ack register
condition.note: Do not compare workbench lab to the retrieved test lab. Print only after REGISTERED.

slides.notes: STAR with no workbench location is Failure. Mixed local and send-out is Failure, not a warning. DFT uses the same Spec Ack register packing as an ordinary specimen.

slides.title: What the screen packs today moves behind the API

steps.title: Group tests and assign the request number
steps.body: Tests for this specimen are grouped. The USID is the request number when eligible.

steps.title: Map ward and doctor
steps.body: Office dictionary mapping the screen does today is done on the server.

steps.title: Replace ticks with defaults
steps.body: Ack time is now. AAR off. Urgent workstation off. Labels off. No relabel tick.

sidebar.headline: Pack first
sidebar.body: If we only move the hard checks, the write has no test groups.
points: Soft alerts go to ALS only

slides.notes: Moving only the hard checks still leaves an empty test-group list.

slides.title: Print only after Registered

takeaways.title: Late print is allowed
takeaways.body: A late worksheet does not change a REGISTERED status already returned.

takeaways.title: Print all, no picker
takeaways.body: Staff worksheet picker is gone. Every worksheet the packing produced is printed.

slides.notes: Send-out never prints. The ack auto-print flag is not used. Staff picker goes away: print all on the registration path.

slides.title: Seed user, workbench, and map, then deploy

cards.title: Create the sorter user
cards.body: A dedicated LIS user on the audit trail. Not a shared staff login.

cards.title: Seed a workbench row
cards.body: One row per sorter: hosp, lab, station name, location, printer.

cards.title: Insert the map row
cards.body: Sorter id, user, workbench id, lab, hosp, server name on loe_sorter_map.

cards.title: Deploy and open the path
cards.body: Deploy lis-crs-spec-ack-svc. NetworkPolicy only. Add SORT_* to the Audit Trail filter.

slides.notes: Printer and STAR location come from workbench, not copied onto the map. Audit workstation is the workbench station name. Still write REG and SEND_OUT. Pilot CPS and HMS; Relabel and Failure bins go back to staff Spec Ack.

slides.title: Stop middleware. Staff Spec Ack is unchanged

cards.title: Stop middleware
cards.body: Staff clicks still retrieve, send-out, and register. The staff screen is untouched.

cards.title: Drop the map table
cards.body: DROP TABLE loe_sorter_map on full rollback. Leave or disable the workbench and user.

cards.title: No history rewrite
cards.body: Do not convert historical requests. Fallback is operational, not a data rewrite.

slides.notes: The staff path is the fallback. Drop only the map table. Workbench and user can stay inactive.

slides.title: Four decisions to ratify before build

asks.q: Leave v1 with NetworkPolicy only, no API key or Hub JWT?
asks.why: Same isolation as Spec Ack today (D1).

asks.q: Fail the tube when the USID has both local and send-out tests?
Print worksheets and PHLC only after Registered, after HTTP return?
Show SORT_* actions on the Audit Trail filter?

callout.text: Requester already answered D1-D11. This room ratifies.

slides.notes: Requester already answered D1-D11. This room is the ratification, not a new design pass.

slides.headline: Q&A
slides.notes: Likely questions: why not reuse the staff register API; why DFT does not use a separate DFT API; why workbench lab is not checked against the test lab.

slides.headline: Target latency
slides.note: About 20 specimens a minute per lab in v1. Worksheet and PHLC sit after the sorter wait path.
